fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of Gross Sales, paid weekly. Non-Compliance Charge can increase royalty to 7% for general non-compliance or up to 10% for under-reporting exceeding $10,000 in 12 months. Marketing Fee is currently 2% of Gross Sales but may increase; combined Marketing Fee and required local advertising expense capped at 5% of Gross Sales. Technology Fee is currently $250/month, may increase to $500/month upon notice; subsequent increases capped at 50% of prior year-end rate on a compounded basis. Additional notable fees: Branded Email Address Fee $50/month per account (beyond 1); Collection of Local Advertising Expense Upon Default currently 1% of Gross Sales plus $500/month administrative fee; Step-In Rights Fee 15% of Gross Sales plus expenses; Transfer Fee greater of $5,000 or 5% of purchase price plus $5,000; Successor Franchise Fee 50% of then-current initial franchise fee; Late Reporting Fee $100/day; Relocation Fee $5,000 plus expenses; Annual Franchisee Meeting Fee $2,500/person (may increase up to 10% annually on compounded basis); Initial Training $2,000/person for additional/replacement trainees; Additional On-Site Training $4,000/trainer for first two days then $2,000/trainer/day; Interest 18% or highest legal rate on overdue amounts; Prohibited Product Fee $500/product/day; Re-inspection Fee $500 plus actual costs; Manual/Training Video Replacement Fee $5,000.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 6% of Gross Sales. | Weekly, on the date we specify (currently, Monday) | Royalty Fees are calculated based on Gross Sales for the previous week and are paid electronically.
Marketing Fee | Currently, 2% of Gross Sales, but may increase subject to the Marketing Cap. | Weekly, payable in the same manner as the Royalty Fee | We may increase this amount by providing 30 days written notice to you; however, we will not require the Marketing Fee and the minimum required local advertising expense to exceed 5% of Gross Sales ("Marketing Cap").
Technology Fee | Currently, $250 per month | Monthly, as invoiced | We may periodically change the amount of the technology fee payable to us. We may increase the technology fee to $500 per month at any time upon notice to you; however, any subsequent increase in the technology fee may not, in a given calendar year, exceed 50% of the Technology Fee in effect during the last month of the immediately preceding calendar year on a compounded basis.
